fusions.name: Battering Slug
fusions.desc: Fires a blunt slug into the first enemy in its path, which deals 14 damage and knocks it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Startle Bleat
fusions.desc: Bleats a sharp crack in a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 4 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Ridge Perch
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Skipping Shot
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, a shot snaps to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
